mann.title: Flag of the Isle of Man

colors.note: The traditional colour of the Isle of Man.
The three-legged triskelion (Three Legs of Man).

desc:
- A red field with the triskelion (three armoured legs) at the centre
- The triskelion has been a symbol of the Isle of Man for centuries
- The motto 'Quocunque Jeceris Stabit' (Whichever way you throw me, I will stand) accompanies the emblem
- **Construction:** a red field with the triskelion (three armoured legs in armour) centred
- The legs are arranged at 120° intervals, running clockwise (dexter)
trivia:
- The Isle of Man is a British Crown dependency with its own distinct flag
- The three-legged symbol (triskele) represents endurance and resilience
- The legs rotate clockwise and appear to be in motion
